validatedControls: Migration 015 replaces installed Migration 014 selection triggers
hash_schema_version 1 artifacts are audited and quarantined
hash_schema_version 2 binds artifact identity, lifecycle, Rule Set content and profile content hashes
three distinct reviewer roles and instances are required
normalized artifact lines and review coverage must match JSON line arrays and exact quotes
BLOCKER, REVISE, HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED and requiresHumanApproval cannot be hidden by score
selection evidence and authority rows are immutable after their permitted lifecycle
review intake and selection are atomic during finalization
blocked CLI finalization returns exit code 2 and does not print a selected hash
residualRisks: Reviewer independence is represented by distinct instance IDs rather than cryptographic identities.
An actor with unrestricted raw SQLite write authority can fabricate a fully self-consistent evidence set; the project boundary continues to prohibit bypassing the official Repository.
The migration parser remains format-constrained rather than a complete SQL tokenizer.
